paite: Huchi in Ammon mi Nahash ahong kisa a, Jabesh-gilead sual tum in ava giahkhum hi. Jabesh mi tengteng in Nahash kiang ah, "Kou toh thukhun bawl in, huchi in nang nna ka sem ding uh," achi uh.
heading: Saul In Ammonte Azou
english: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabesh Gilead; and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, “Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you.”

paite: Ammon mi Nahash in akiang uah, "Hichibang in ahi nou toh thu ka khun ding. Na mit taklam tengteng uh khelkhiak vek ahi dia; huai Israel mi tengteng minsiatna dia koih ahi ding," achi hi.
english: Nahash the Ammonite said to them, “On this condition I will make it with you, that all your right eyes be gouged out. I will make this dishonor all Israel.”

paite: Jabesh khua upate'n akiang ah, "Israel gam tengteng a thupo mite ka sawltheihna ding un ni sagih sung hon hungaih in. Hon hondam ding kuamah a-om keileh na kiang ah ka hong paikhe ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The elders of Jabesh said to him, “Give us seven days, that we may send messengers to all the borders of Israel; and then, if there is no one to save us, we will come out to you.”

paite: Huchi in huai thupo mite Saul omna khua Gibeah ahong tung uhi. Mite bil azak in huai thute agen ua; mite aw suah in akap uhi,
english: Then the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul, and spoke these words in the ears of the people, then all the people lifted up their voice and wept.

paite: Ngai in, lou a pan bawng hawl in Saul ahong pai hi. Saul in, "Bang achi ua ahia mite akah uh?" achi hi. Jabesh a mite thugen ahilh uhi.
english: Behold, Saul came following the oxen out of the field; and Saul said, “What ails the people that they weep?” They told him the words of the men of Jabesh.

paite: Huai thu azaktak in Saul tung ah Pathian Kha ahong tung a nakpitak in ahehta hi.
english: God’s Spirit came mightily on Saul when he heard those words, and his anger burned hot.

paite: Huchi in bawngtal nih ala a, asemnen vek hi. Israel gam tengteng ah thupo mite ahawmsak a, "Kuapeuh Saul leh Samuel zui nuam lou peuhmah hiai bawngtal bang a hih ahi ding," achi hi. Huchi in mipite'n TOUPA alau ua, thukhat sat in ahong kuankheta uh.
english: He took a yoke of oxen and cut them in pieces, then sent them throughout all the borders of Israel by the hand of messengers, saying, “Whoever doesn’t come out after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done to his oxen.” The dread of Yahweh fell on the people, and they came out as one man.

paite: Bezek ah amaute asim a, Israel mite nuaithum ahi uh. Judah mite singthum ahi uh.
english: He counted them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

paite: Ahong pai thupo mite kiang ah, "Jabesh-gilead mite kiang ah, zingchiang in nisat san laitak mah in hotkhiak na hi ding uh va chi un," achi hi. Thupo mite ava hoh ua, Jabesh mite ahilh ua, huchi in akipak mahmah uhi.
english: They said to the messengers who came, “Tell the men of Jabesh Gilead, ‘Tomorrow, by the time the sun is hot, you will be rescued.’” The messengers came and told the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.

paite: Huchi in Jabesh mite'n, "Zingchiang in na kiang uah ka hong pawtkhe ding ua, ka tung uah na ut-ut un hih mai un," achi uhi.
english: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, “Tomorrow we will come out to you, and you shall do with us all that seems good to you.”

paite: Hichi ahong hi a, azing in Saul in mipite pawl thum in akoih a, zing ven hun laitak in agiahmun uah alut uhi. Ammon mite sun nisat san lai tan in athat uhi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, athahvalte adalhzak vek ua, nih a omkhawm himhim leng a-om kei uhi.
english: On the next day, Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the middle of the camp in the morning watch, and struck the Ammonites until the heat of the day. Those who remained were scattered, so that no two of them were left together.

paite: Mipite'n Samuel kiang ah, "Kuate ahia, Saul in i tung uah vai ahawm tel ding maw chi? Huai mite hon pi in ka that ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The people said to Samuel, “Who is he who said, ‘Shall Saul reign over us?’ Bring those men, that we may put them to death!”

paite: Saul in, "Tuni chitchiat in zaw kuamah that kei un. Tuni in TOUPA'N Israelte lak ah hotdamna abawlta ngal a," achi hi.
english: Saul said, “No man shall be put to death today; for today Yahweh has rescued Israel.”

paite: Huchi in Samuel in mipite kiang ah, "Kisa dih uh, Gilgal ah i hoh ding ua, huai ah lalgam i thaksak nawn ding uh," achi hi.
english: Then Samuel said to the people, “Come! Let’s go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.”

paite: Huchi in mite tengteng Gilgal ah ahohta uhi. Saul Gilgal ah TOUPA ma ah kumpipa in abawlta uhi. Huai ah TOUPA ma ah lemna kithoihnate alan uhi. Huchi in huai ah Saul leh Israel mi tengteng akipak mahmah uhi.
english: All the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before Yahweh in Gilgal. There they offered sacrifices of peace offerings before Yahweh; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.
